slide3_topic_title: 当债券不再扮演债券：60/40股债平衡组合是否已死？
monthly_conflict_calibration: 长端美债收益率与固收资产校准：研报强调警惕长端美债与久期风险，本组合坚持纯股票高增长架构配搭大华黄金与富敦绝对收益底仓，规避了传统60/40组合在股债正相关环境下的减震失效陷阱。

manager_input.qualitative_view: 当月的组合回报不及基准指数，主要是黄金基金在8月24%单月暴涨之后的收益落袋。云巨头八千亿美元资本开支与存储芯片产能售罄印证亚洲算力高景气，叠加国内超常规政策刺激及股债正相关下“纯权益增长+35%富敦市场中性底仓+10.5%穿透纯金对冲”三支柱稳健协同，底层安全边际厚实。虽美联储加息推升十年期美债收益率破5.2%及中东油价破百带来短期分母端扰动。
manager_input.qualitative_view_en: Monthly portfolio return trailed the benchmark index primarily due to profit-taking in the Gold fund following its 24% single-month surge in August. USD 800bn hyperscaler CapEx and sold-out memory chip capacity validate Asian compute momentum, reinforced by domestic stimulus and our three-pillar architecture (pure equity growth + 35% Fullerton market-neutral core + 10.5% look-through pure gold hedge) amid positive stock-bond correlations. Despite Fed rate hikes pushing 10Y Treasury yields above 5.2% and Middle East oil surpassing USD 100 causing short-term denominator headwinds, underlying safety margins remain solid.
manager_input.rebalance_note: 坚守三支柱战略配置，维持板块分配。建议亚洲除日本板块更换标的（候选参考标的：M&G (Lux) Asian Fund，详见调仓说明备忘录）。
manager_input.rebalance_note_en: Maintain 3-pillar strategy and asset allocation. Suggest replacing Asia ex-Japan holding (Candidate Reference: M&G (Lux) Asian Fund; see Alteration Memo).
